description: Opens update PRs for the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions and the CI tool versions. Nothing is merged automatically: the release toolchain (release-please, attestation, Inno Setup) builds what users run as administrator, and CI cannot detect a backdoored tool, so every update gets a human review.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, committed as ci(deps)
CI tools (Chocolatey, PowerShell Gallery): committed as build(deps)

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with '# renovate:' comments in workflows
